author: TeIq
content:
Resolution: proto-blue 0.3.2 published upstream with rust-version correctly declared as 1.88. Polaris bumped to match.

Changes applied:
- rust-toolchain.toml: channel 1.85 → 1.88
- Cargo.toml workspace.package: rust-version "1.85" → "1.88"
- Cargo.toml workspace.dependencies: leptos pin relaxed from "0.8.3" to "0.8" (was pinned only because of the same MSRV issue)
- cargo update pulled proto-blue + all 13 sub-crates from 0.3.1 to 0.3.2

Verification under rustc 1.88.0:
- cargo build --workspace: clean (33.36s).
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean (26.45s).
- cargo fmt --check: clean.
- AC-8 invariant intact: cargo tree -p polaris-types --depth 1 shows only chrono / serde / serde_json / uuid. No proto-blue.

Workspace is now in the state #7's evidence floor originally required. #8 and #10 unblocked.
